authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL cillaṭa/cillaḍa explicitly gives Hindi cīl(h)aṛ/cīl(h)ar and cillaṛ/cillar louse. Dang Tharu čilur/čɪlra/čɪlər/čilra fits that family with source vowel, syncope and rhotic notation retained. The dictionary itself supplies the louse sense, so no inference from a generic creeping-animal gloss is required. Regional IA transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: čilur.
